t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, yellow, orange, brown gnomes are in one category and red, purple, pink, blue gnomes are in another. Each category will give you a different chance of collecting more mushrooms. This chance will change throughout the game so you might need to test your theory if you see the number of mushrooms you are collecting start to decrease.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are split into two categories with different coloured mushroom collections baskets. Red basket - orange, yellow, green and brown gnomes. Yellow basket - pink, purple, red and blue gnomes. Each category will give you a higher chance of collecting more mushrooms it different points throughout the game. Work out initially which category is giving the higher chance of mushrooms and continue with this category. If the number of mushrooms collected decreases significantly try the other category and continue with that one.
